zh.title: 國防部偵獲7艘共艦及6艘公務船持續在台海周邊活動
zh.summary: 國防部指出台海周邊偵獲共艦7艘與公務船6艘活動；統計期間未偵獲共機。
body: 中華民國國防部於2026年8月28日上午發布中共解放軍台海周邊海、空域動態表示，自8月27日上午6時至8月28日上午6時止，國軍共計偵獲共艦7艘以及公務船6艘，持續在台灣海峽周邊海域活動。
國防部強調，針對在台海周邊活動的7艘共艦與6艘公務船，國軍已即時運用任務機、任務艦以及岸置飛彈系統，進行嚴密監控與相關應處作業。
此外，國防部在說明中特別指出，自27日上午6時至28日上午6時的24小時統計期間內，並未偵獲任何中共軍機活動，因此本次動態未額外提供軍機航跡示意圖。

en.title: Taiwan MND Tracks 7 PLA Vessels and 6 Official Ships Near Island
en.summary: Taiwan MND detected seven PLA vessels and six official ships; no aircraft were tracked during period.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 28, 2026, that it detected seven People's Liberation Army Navy vessels and six official ships operating in the waters around the Taiwan Strait over the preceding 24-hour monitoring period.

According to the defense ministry, the tracking period ran from 06:00 on August 27 to 06:00 on August 28. In response to the maritime activity, Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the movements of the military and official vessels.

The ministry also noted that no PLA aircraft were detected in the airspace near Taiwan during the same 24-hour period. Consequently, no flight track map was published alongside the daily operational report.
